input: Get a sports massage after the charity run

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The date of the charity run determines the booking deadline and how much lead time exists to find and secure a therapist.
Whether the massage is on-site at the event, at a nearby clinic, or at home affects which providers are even options.
Sports massages vary widely in price; the budget determines which therapists or services are realistic.
How soon after finishing the run the user wants the massage affects scheduling — same day, same hour, or the day after are very different logistics.
Duration and focus area (e.g. legs only vs. full body) changes what to look for and what to communicate to the therapist.
Whether the user already has a trusted therapist or needs to find a new one determines whether this is a booking task or also a research task.

keyUnknowns.axis: success criteria / what done looks like
keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether success means a confirmed booking in hand vs. just a shortlist of options shapes how far to take the plan.

gold.taskTitle: Book a sports massage after the charity run
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to arrange a sports massage as recovery following a charity run event.

questions.title: When exactly is the charity run taking place?
questions.description: Establish the date (and approximate finish time) of the run to set the booking deadline and available lead time.

questions.title: Where do you want the massage to happen?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants an on-site therapist at the event venue, a nearby clinic they travel to, or a mobile therapist who comes to them.

questions.title: How soon after finishing do you want it?
questions.description: Determine the desired timing — immediately post-race, later the same day, or the following day — to identify realistic booking windows.

questions.title: Do you have a therapist in mind, or need to find one?
questions.description: Find out if the user has an existing preferred therapist or if sourcing and vetting a new one is part of the task.

questions.title: What is your budget for the session?
questions.description: Establish a price range so that only suitably priced therapists and clinics are considered.

questions.title: How long a session, and which body areas should it cover?
questions.description: Clarify the desired treatment duration and focus — legs only, full body, etc. — to communicate clearly with the therapist and filter providers.

questions.title: What does this task look like when it is done?
questions.description: Determine whether success means a fully confirmed, paid booking or simply a curated shortlist of options ready to choose from.
questions.coversAxis: success criteria / what done looks like
